mapper.sql: select b.id, b.customer_id, b.delivery_date, b.scope_type, b.merge_same_item, b.template_id, b.layout_json, b.status, b.version, b.is_deleted, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, b.remark, coalesce(customer.alias, customer.name) as customerName from t_delivery_batch b left join t_customer customer on customer.id = b.customer_id
mapper.insert:
insert into t_delivery_batch
customer_id, delivery_date, scope_type, merge_same_item, template_id, layout_json, status, version, is_deleted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark,
#{customerId}, #{deliveryDate}, #{scopeType}, #{mergeSameItem}, #{templateId}, #{layoutJson}, #{status}, #{version}, #{isDeleted}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark},
mapper.select: select si.sku_id as skuId, coalesce(sku.name, si.product_name) as productName, dod.product_spec as spec, dod.product_unit as unit, si.customer_dept_id as deptId, cd.name as deptName, sum(si.allocated_quantity) as quantity from t_delivery_source_item si join t_delivery_order o on o.id = si.delivery_id and o.is_deleted = 0 and o.status != 3 join t_delivery_order_detail dod on dod.id = si.delivery_detail_id left join t_product_sku sku on sku.id = si.sku_id left join t_customer_dept cd on cd.id = si.customer_dept_id where si.is_deleted = 0 and o.customer_id = #{customerId} and o.delivery_date = #{deliveryDate} group by si.sku_id, coalesce(sku.name, si.product_name), dod.product_spec, dod.product_unit, si.customer_dept_id, cd.name order by productName, spec, unit, deptName

select dod.sku_id as skuId, coalesce(sku.name, dod.product_name) as productName, dod.product_spec as spec, dod.product_unit as unit, coalesce(dod.customer_dept_id, o.delivery_point_id) as deptId, cd.name as deptName, sum(dod.num) as quantity from t_delivery_order_detail dod join t_delivery_order o on o.id = dod.delivery_id and o.is_deleted = 0 and o.status != 3 left join t_product_sku sku on sku.id = dod.sku_id left join t_customer_dept cd on cd.id = coalesce(dod.customer_dept_id, o.delivery_point_id) where dod.is_deleted = 0 and o.customer_id = #{customerId} and o.delivery_date = #{deliveryDate} group by dod.sku_id, coalesce(sku.name, dod.product_name), dod.product_spec, dod.product_unit, coalesce(dod.customer_dept_id, o.delivery_point_id), cd.name order by productName, spec, unit, deptName

select tcd.id as deptId, tcd.code as code, tcd.name as name from t_customer_dept tcd where tcd.customer_id = #{customerId} and tcd.valid = 1 and tcd.is_deleted = 0 and tcd.parent_id is not null and tcd.parent_id != 0 order by tcd.code, tcd.id

select min(d.id) as detailId, null as deliveryId, null as deliveryCode, null as docKind, d.sku_id as skuId, d.product_name as productName, coalesce(sku.name, d.product_name) as stdProductName, d.product_spec as spec, d.product_unit as unit, sum(d.num) as num, d.product_price as price from t_sale_order_detail d join t_sale_order o on o.id = d.order_id and o.is_deleted = 0 and o.status >= 1 left join t_product_sku sku on sku.id = d.sku_id where d.is_deleted = 0 and o.customer_id = #{customerId} and o.delivery_date = #{deliveryDate} group by d.sku_id, d.product_name, coalesce(sku.name, d.product_name), d.product_spec, d.product_unit, d.product_price having sum(d.num) > 0 order by stdProductName, spec, unit, price

select min(d.id) as detailId, coalesce(d.customer_dept_id, o.customer_dept_id) as deptId, d.sku_id as skuId, d.product_name as productName, d.product_spec as spec, d.product_unit as unit, d.product_price as price, sum(d.num) as quantity from t_sale_order_detail d join t_sale_order o on o.id = d.order_id and o.is_deleted = 0 and o.status >= 1 where d.is_deleted = 0 and o.customer_id = #{customerId} and o.delivery_date = #{deliveryDate} group by d.sku_id, d.product_name, d.product_spec, d.product_unit, d.product_price, coalesce(d.customer_dept_id, o.customer_dept_id) having sum(d.num) > 0

select d.sku_id as skuId, coalesce(sku.name, d.product_name) as productName, d.product_spec as spec, d.product_unit as unit, coalesce(d.customer_dept_id, o.customer_dept_id) as deptId, cd.name as deptName, sum(d.num) as quantity from t_sale_order_detail d join t_sale_order o on o.id = d.order_id and o.is_deleted = 0 and o.status >= 1 left join t_product_sku sku on sku.id = d.sku_id left join t_customer_dept cd on cd.id = coalesce(d.customer_dept_id, o.customer_dept_id) where d.is_deleted = 0 and o.customer_id = #{customerId} and o.delivery_date = #{deliveryDate} group by d.sku_id, coalesce(sku.name, d.product_name), d.product_spec, d.product_unit, coalesce(d.customer_dept_id, o.customer_dept_id), cd.name having sum(d.num) > 0 order by productName, spec, unit, deptName

select d.id as detailId, d.delivery_id as deliveryId, o.code as deliveryCode, o.doc_kind as docKind, d.sku_id as skuId, d.product_name as productName, coalesce(sku.name, d.product_name) as stdProductName, d.product_spec as spec, d.product_unit as unit, d.num as num, d.price as price from t_delivery_order_detail d join t_delivery_order o on o.id = d.delivery_id and o.is_deleted = 0 and o.status != 3 left join t_product_sku sku on sku.id = d.sku_id where d.is_deleted = 0 and o.customer_id = #{customerId} and o.delivery_date = #{deliveryDate} order by o.doc_kind, o.id, d.id

select si.delivery_detail_id as detailId, si.customer_dept_id as deptId, sum(si.allocated_quantity) as quantity from t_delivery_source_item si join t_delivery_order o on o.id = si.delivery_id and o.is_deleted = 0 and o.status != 3 where si.is_deleted = 0 and o.customer_id = #{customerId} and o.delivery_date = #{deliveryDate} group by si.delivery_detail_id, si.customer_dept_id
